rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who generally lacks courage or confidence.

example.english: They have always been timid and never dare speak when they see strangers.
example.traditional: 佢由細到大都好膽小，見到陌生人就唔敢出聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 hou2 daam2 siu2 gin3 dou2 mak6 sang1 jan4 zau6 m4 gam2 ceot1 seng1

rows.note: Use this when the timidity is mainly shyness or self-consciousness around other people.

example.english: They are so timid that they blush even when asked to sing a song on stage.
example.traditional: 佢咁怕醜，叫佢上台唱首歌都面紅。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 paa3 cau2 giu3 keoi5 soeng5 toi1 coeng3 sau2 go1 dou1 min6 hung4

rows.note: Use this when someone is timid because they avoid confrontation, trouble, or risk.

example.english: I’m not timid; I just don’t want to argue with anyone.
example.traditional: 我唔係怕事，只係唔想同人嘈。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 paa3 si6 zi2 hai6 m4 soeng2 tung4 jan4 cou4
